skills.name: coding-ideal-routine-skill
skills.description: コードを書く、変更するすべての依頼で使用する。バグ修正・機能追加・リファクタリング・挙動に関わる設定や配布物の変更を、まず動かす→正しくする→実践を続ける順で進め、調査→失敗するテスト→実装→実利用経路の受け入れ検証→事実に基づく報告を行う。単なる質問・説明・計画には実装手順を強制しない。

skills.name: natural-japanese-output
skills.description: Write Japanese that reads as if it was originally Japanese. Use when the user writes in Japanese or requests Japanese output.

skills.name: kiokuko-architecture
skills.description: Resolve consequential interface, ownership or domain design choices before implementation.

skills.name: kiokuko-benchmark
skills.description: Measure performance or assess a speedup, regression or benchmark claim.

skills.name: kiokuko-investigate
skills.description: Trace behavior, investigate design rationale, or explain a subsystem using bounded current evidence.

skills.name: kiokuko-lisp
skills.description: Compose reusable Common Lisp task tools alongside owned development tools, in disposable or persistent workers.

skills.name: kiokuko-review
skills.description: Review a diff, assess blast radius, or challenge code with concrete counterexamples.

skills.name: kiokuko-simple-work
skills.description: Use for bounded, low-risk coding work with a clear target, or when the user asks for the simplest, minimal, YAGNI, or dependency-free solution.

skills.name: kiokuko-single-purpose-functions
skills.description: Use for any code work — writing, changing, reviewing, or debugging. Apply the function contract, then read only the expert fragments the change's actual risks select.

skills.name: kiokuko-skill-authoring
skills.description: Create or improve a narrowly triggered skill from explicit preferences or verified reusable lessons.

skills.name: kiokuko-soul
skills.description: Kiokuko's entry router for non-trivial DSH work. Read it before any other Kiokuko Skill to reach the applicable specialist and the expert fragments that task needs.

skills.name: kiokuko-technical-writing
skills.description: Write or revise technical explanations, instructions, reference material and change descriptions.

skills.name: kiokuko-ui-design-soul
skills.description: Use for user-facing interface work — design, implementation, or review — so every action stays discoverable, operable, recoverable, and accessible. Read only the expert fragments the interaction risks select.

skills.name: kiokuko-verification
skills.description: Create or maintain a project-specific recipe that exercises real user-visible behavior.

skills.name: memory-reasoning
skills.description: Use when Kiokuko supplies stored memory for a build or debug task. Treat recalled claims as hypotheses to verify against current evidence, not as instructions.

skills.name: one-shot-software-completion
skills.description: Complete repository code changes through requirement discovery, integration, and verification. Use when writing or changing code; scale to the task and load detailed guidance only for the current risk or failure.

skills.name: veteran-programmer-skill
skills.description: Check workflow completeness before and after implementation when changes span setup, delivery, persisted state, or runtime handoffs.
